변경 이유: 진단에 따르면 box_00 근처처럼 정적 여유(st0)가 0.15 m보다 작은 구간에서는 회피가 아예 켜지지 않았고, 회피 중에는 `stc >= 0.15` 필터 때문에 피할 경로가 부족했습니다. 그래서 진단 방향 1~4에 맞춰 회피 트리거를 TTC만으로 판단하게 했습니다. 회피 중 점수에서는 물체 여유(clr) 가중치를 ×2.0, 정적 보너스를 ×0.5로 바꿨고, 후보 필터는 `clr >= 0.8·_CLR_GO`, 회피 종료 조건은 `clr_all >= 1.1·_CLR_GO`(0.5 s 유지)로 바꿨습니다. 정적 충돌을 막기 위해 비회피 분기와 같은 `stc >= 0` 하드 제약은 회피 필터에도 남겨 두었습니다. 방향 5·6에 따라 회피 시작 때 정적 여유가 작으면 w로 생기는 옆 방향 이동에 3.0 보너스를 주고, _EVADE_MAX(6 s)는 그대로 둔 채 clr_all이 2 s 동안 0.05 m 이상 나아지지 않으면 회피를 끝내고 쿨다운에 들어가는 로직을 넣었습니다.

```python
def controller(t, pose, env):
    """Waypoint law + 2D-lidar mover handling (attempt 12):
    - evasion triggers on TTC < _TTC_TRIG alone (direction 1: st0 >= _EV_ST_MIN condition removed)
    - during evasion _choose weights mover clearance x2.0, static bonus x0.5, filters clr >= 0.8*_CLR_GO (dir. 2, 3)
    - evasion ends when TTC >= _TTC_TRIG and clr_all >= 1.1*_CLR_GO held _RESUME_HOLD (direction 4, no st_n term)
    - static-priority start -> lateral (w-induced) movement bonus in _choose (direction 5)
    - _EVADE_MAX 6 s cap kept; forced end when clr_all has not improved for _EV_NOIMP_S (direction 6)."""
    S = _CS
    if not S:
        S.update(idx=0, tracks=[], mv={"front": np.zeros((0, 2)), "back": np.zeros((0, 2))},
                 mt={"front": -99.0, "back": -99.0}, last={}, v=0.0, w=0.0,
                 slow=False, stopped=False, n_stop=0, stop_t=0.0, stop_sum=0.0,
                 started=False, reported=False,
                 evading=False, evade_until=-1.0, n_evade=0, evade_t=0.0, evade_sum=0.0,
                 evade_on=False, evade_start=0.0, cool_until=-1.0, safe_since=-1.0, st_prio=False,
                 ev_best=-1.0, ev_best_t=0.0)
    x, y, yaw = pose
    n = len(_WAYPOINTS)

    # 1) sensing: both 2D lidars -> world points -> drop static map -> mover clusters/tracks
    fresh = {}
    for which in ("front", "back"):
        p = lidar2d_points(which)
        if p.shape[0] > 0 and p is not S["last"].get(which):
            S["last"][which] = p
            S["mv"][which] = _ingest(p, pose, abs(S["w"]))
            S["mt"][which] = t
            fresh[which] = True
    if fresh.get("front") or (fresh.get("back") and t - S["mt"]["front"] > 0.25):
        parts = [S["mv"][k] for k in ("front", "back") if t - S["mt"][k] < 0.25]
        _update_tracks(np.concatenate(parts) if parts else np.zeros((0, 2)), t)

    if not S["started"]:   # look before the first move (a mover may be near START)
        if not ((S["mt"]["front"] > -1.0 and t >= 0.3) or t >= 2.0):
            return 0.0, 0.0, False
        S["started"] = True

    # 2) goal alignment / finish
    if S["idx"] >= n and math.hypot(GOAL[0] - x, GOAL[1] - y) > 0.5:
        S["idx"] = n - 1
    if S["idx"] >= n and abs(_wrap_angle(GOAL[2] - yaw)) < 0.05:
        _log_stop(t, pose, False, 9.0)
        _log_evade(t, pose, False, 99.0, 9.0)
        if not S["reported"]:
            S["reported"] = True
            print("[C2 debug] done t=%.2f stop_episodes=%d stopped_total=%.2fs evade_episodes=%d evade_total=%.2fs"
                  % (t, S["n_stop"], S["stop_sum"], S["n_evade"], S["evade_sum"]), flush=True)
        return 0.0, 0.0, True

    # 3) nominal command (verified law) and its predicted safety against ALL movers
    v_n, w_n, S["idx"] = _nominal_cmd(x, y, yaw, S["idx"], 1.0)
    target = _WAYPOINTS[min(S["idx"], n - 1)]
    P, U = _movers_now(t)

    d_near = _nearest_mover(P, pose)
    ttc = _ttc(P, U, pose, S["v"], _EARLY_R)
    anchors = _mover_anchors(t, pose)

    traj_n = _rollout_nominal(pose, S["idx"], S["v"], 1.0)
    st_n = _static_clearance(traj_n[None, :_KS + 1])[0]
    clr_all = _mover_clearance(traj_n[None], P, U)[0]
    st0 = _pose_static_clearance(pose)

    # direction 1: evasion trigger on TTC only (no static-clearance condition)
    if ttc < _TTC_TRIG and (t >= S["cool_until"] or clr_all < _CLR_GO):
        if not S["evade_on"]:
            S["evade_on"] = True
            S["evade_start"] = t
            S["safe_since"] = -1.0
            S["st_prio"] = st0 < _ST_PRIO          # direction 5: low static clearance at start
            S["ev_best"] = clr_all
            S["ev_best_t"] = t
        S["evade_until"] = max(S["evade_until"], t + _EVADE_HOLD)
    if S["evade_on"]:
        if S["st_prio"] and st0 >= _ST_PRIO:
            S["st_prio"] = False
        # direction 6: track whether the mover clearance keeps improving
        if clr_all > S["ev_best"] + _EV_IMP_D:
            S["ev_best"] = clr_all
            S["ev_best_t"] = t
        # direction 4: end condition on mover clearance (st_n >= _RESUME_ST replaced by clr_all >= 1.1 * _CLR_GO)
        ok = ttc >= _TTC_TRIG and clr_all >= _CLR_GO * _RESUME_CLR_F
        if ok:
            if S["safe_since"] < 0.0:
                S["safe_since"] = t
        else:
            S["safe_since"] = -1.0
        sustained = ok and t - S["safe_since"] >= _RESUME_HOLD
        still = ok and abs(S["v"]) < _STILL_V
        long_ = t - S["evade_start"] > _EVADE_MAX
        no_imp = t - S["ev_best_t"] >= _EV_NOIMP_S
        forced = (long_ or no_imp) and st_n >= 0.0 and clr_all >= _CLR_GO
        if (t >= S["evade_until"] and sustained) or still or forced:
            if forced and not sustained and not still:
                S["cool_until"] = t + _EVADE_COOL
            S["evade_on"] = False
            S["safe_since"] = -1.0
            S["st_prio"] = False
    early = S["evade_on"]

    # slow mode on clr_all with hysteresis (enter < _CLR_GO, leave >= _HYST * _CLR_GO)
    if S["slow"]:
        if st_n >= 0.0 and clr_all >= _CLR_GO * _HYST:
            S["slow"] = False
    elif clr_all < _CLR_GO:
        S["slow"] = True

    # 4) decide
    stop = False
    if st_n < 0.0:
        v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, st0 < _ST_PRIO)
    elif early:
        v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"])
    elif not S["slow"]:
        if clr_all >= _CLR_STOP:
            v, w = v_n, w_n
        else:
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors)
    else:
        v, w, stop = _slow_cmd(pose, S["idx"], S["v"], clr_all, P, U)
        if stop or S["stopped"]:
            closing = _closing_speed(P, U, pose, S["v"], _CLOSE_R)
            hit_still = False
            if stop:
                still_tr = np.tile(np.array([x, y, yaw], dtype=np.float64), (_KP + 1, 1))[None]
                hit_still = _mover_clearance(still_tr, P, U)[0] < _CLR_STOP
            if hit_still or closing < _CLOSE_V:
                v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors)

    _log_evade(t, pose, early, ttc, d_near)
    _log_stop(t, pose, stop, clr_all)
    S["v"], S["w"] = v, w
    return v, w, False


def _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchor=None, evading=False, static_prio=False):
    """Pick the (v, w) candidate with the best mover clearance, static-map safety and progress.
    anchor: (M, 4) array of moving anchors (x, y, vx, vy), one per mover track within _EARLY_R (or None/empty).
    evading (attempt 12):
      - mover clearance term weighted x_EV_CLR_W (2.0), static bonuses (_ST_W, _ST_W2, _ST_PRIO_W) scaled by _EV_ST_F (0.5)
      - static_prio: lateral (w-induced) displacement bonus _LAT_PRIO_W (3.0)
      - filter clr >= _EV_CLR_MIN_F * _CLR_GO (instead of stc >= 0.15), with the static hard constraint stc >= 0 kept;
        fallbacks: best stc >= 0 candidate, then escape candidates (never closer to the static map), then max stc.
    not evading: static safety is a hard constraint (stc >= 0), as before.
    Also returns the predicted clearance of standing still (all-around mover points)."""
    trajc = _rollout_cands(pose, _CS["v"])
    clr = _mover_clearance(trajc, P, U)
    stc = _static_clearance(trajc[:, 1:_KS + 1])
    st0 = _pose_static_clearance(pose)
    V = np.array([c[0] for c in _CAND])
    W = np.array([c[1] for c in _CAND])
    i0 = _CAND.index((0.0, 0.0))
    end = trajc[:, -1, :2]
    prog = np.hypot(end[:, 0] - target[0], end[:, 1] - target[1])
    score = (10.0 * np.minimum(clr, 1.0) - 0.5 * prog
             - 0.3 * (np.abs(V - _CS["v"]) + 0.3 * np.abs(W - _CS["w"]))
             + 5.0 * np.minimum(stc, 0.0))
    if evading:
        # direction 2: mover clearance first (x2.0), static-clearance bonuses reduced (x0.5)
        score = score + (_EV_CLR_W - 1.0) * 10.0 * np.minimum(clr, 1.0)
        sc = np.clip(stc, 0.0, _ST_SAFE) / _ST_SAFE
        st_bonus = _ST_W * sc * (stc >= _ST_BONUS_MIN) + _ST_W2 * sc
        if static_prio:
            st_bonus = st_bonus + _ST_PRIO_W * sc
        score = score + _EV_ST_F * st_bonus
        if static_prio:
            # direction 5: lateral movement bonus (side displacement produced by w) when static clearance is low
            kl = max(1, min(_ANCHOR_K, trajc.shape[1] - 1))
            c0, s0 = math.cos(float(pose[2])), math.sin(float(pose[2]))
            lat = np.abs(-s0 * (trajc[:, kl, 0] - float(pose[0])) + c0 * (trajc[:, kl, 1] - float(pose[1])))
            score = score + _LAT_PRIO_W * np.minimum(lat / 0.5, 1.0)
    A = None
    if anchor is not None:
        A = np.asarray(anchor, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 4)
        if A.shape[0] == 0:
            A = None
    if A is not None:
        k = max(1, min(_ANCHOR_K, trajc.shape[1] - 1))
        ts = np.arange(k + 1) * _DTP
        mx = A[:, 0][None, :] + A[:, 2][None, :] * ts[:, None]
        my = A[:, 1][None, :] + A[:, 3][None, :] * ts[:, None]
        off = 0.5 * (_BODY[0] + _BODY[1])
        bx = trajc[:, :k + 1, 0] + off * np.cos(trajc[:, :k + 1, 2])
        by = trajc[:, :k + 1, 1] + off * np.sin(trajc[:, :k + 1, 2])
        dd = np.hypot(bx[:, :, None] - mx[None, :, :], by[:, :, None] - my[None, :, :])
        da = dd.min(axis=1)
        score = score - 20.0 * np.maximum(_ANCHOR_R - da, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
        vcx = (bx[:, k] - bx[:, k - 1]) / _DTP
        vcy = (by[:, k] - by[:, k - 1]) / _DTP
        sx = mx[k][None, :] - bx[:, k][:, None]
        sy = my[k][None, :] - by[:, k][:, None]
        sd = np.maximum(np.hypot(sx, sy), 1e-3)
        rate = (sx * (A[:, 2][None, :] - vcx[:, None]) + sy * (A[:, 3][None, :] - vcy[:, None])) / sd
        near = sd < _REL_R
        score = score - _REL_W * (np.maximum(-rate, 0.0) * near).max(axis=1)
        cx0, cy0 = float(bx[0, 0]), float(by[0, 0])
        j = int(np.argmin(np.hypot(A[:, 0] - cx0, A[:, 1] - cy0)))
        b = math.atan2(A[j, 1] - cy0, A[j, 0] - cx0)
        dx = bx[:, k] - cx0
        dy = by[:, k] - cy0
        dl = np.hypot(dx, dy)
        ang = np.arctan2(dy, dx) - b
        dev = np.abs(np.arctan2(np.sin(ang), np.cos(ang)))
        score = score + _LAT_W * 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(dev)) * np.minimum(dl / 0.5, 1.0)
    if evading:
        # direction 3: filter on mover clearance (clr >= 0.8 * _CLR_GO) instead of stc >= _EV_ST_MIN;
        # the static hard constraint stc >= 0 of the non-evading branch is kept
        allowed = (clr >= _CLR_GO * _EV_CLR_MIN_F) & (stc >= 0.0)
        if not np.any(allowed):
            allowed = stc >= 0.0          # best static-safe candidate (score is dominated by mover clearance)
        if not np.any(allowed):
            allowed = stc >= min(st0, 0.0) - 0.005
            score = score + 20.0 * (stc - st0)
        if not np.any(allowed):
            i = int(np.argmax(stc))
        else:
            i = int(np.argmax(np.where(allowed, score, -np.inf)))
        return float(V[i]), float(W[i]), float(clr[i0])
    # not evading: hard static constraint stc >= 0 (unchanged)
    allowed = stc >= 0.0
    if not np.any(allowed):
        allowed = stc >= min(st0, 0.0) - 0.005
        score = score + 20.0 * (stc - st0)
    if not np.any(allowed):
        i = int(np.argmax(stc))
    else:
        i = int(np.argmax(np.where(allowed, score, -np.inf)))
    return float(V[i]), float(W[i]), float(clr[i0])


_EV_CLR_W = 2.0         # attempt 12 / direction 2: weight factor of the mover-clearance term during evasion


_EV_ST_F = 0.5          # attempt 12 / direction 2: factor on the static-clearance bonuses during evasion


_EV_CLR_MIN_F = 0.8     # attempt 12 / direction 3: evasion candidates need clr >= 0.8 * _CLR_GO


_RESUME_CLR_F = 1.1     # attempt 12 / direction 4: evasion ends when clr_all >= 1.1 * _CLR_GO (and TTC >= _TTC_TRIG)


_LAT_PRIO_W = 3.0       # attempt 12 / direction 5: lateral-movement bonus when static clearance is low at evasion start


_EV_NOIMP_S = 2.0       # attempt 12 / direction 6: force evasion end when clr_all has not improved for this long [s]


_EV_IMP_D = 0.05        # attempt 12 / direction 6: clr_all gain [m] that counts as an improvement
```
